scope: Intermediate ranges, minmax scale candidates, and derived frozen-scale coefficients; no new bit widths selected
backend: CPU eager FP32 fake-quant with full signed W8/A12/K8/V8 ranges

qparams_policy: Existing scales/zero-points and SmoothQuant s frozen; no qparams rewritten

scale_candidates.policy: Full signed minmax: max(max(0,-min)/2**(b-1), max(0,max)/(2**(b-1)-1)); all-zero tensor uses scale 1
scale_candidates.unsigned_policy: max/(2**b-1) for observed-nonnegative tensors, b=1..32; not proof that unsigned is valid for all inputs
scale_candidates.groups: Per-channel/head min/max retained; apply the same formula to each group to instantiate scales
scale_candidates.limitation: These are observed-range candidate qparams, not approved formats or accuracy guarantees

analytical_domains.score_minus_max: nonpositive on allowed keys; each row has a zero

reference_intermediates: Softmax exp/sum/reciprocal and RMSNorm sum-square are reference arithmetic for profiling, not interception of native kernel internals or selected integer algorithms

histogram.percentiles: Conservative upper bounds from histogram, capped by observed max
histogram.limitation: Observed train distributions, not worst-case bounds or integer-model quality evidence
